To start Docker service, you need to start Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use `docker-machine start default`. But the user might want to start Docker Desktop via command line. We can use `Start-Process "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`.

`cmd /c "net start com.docker.service"`
